description: Sit in a clean base game (no spins) and record it. Exposes gameInfo facts — bet_amount, bet_index, balance, currency, denom_count, min_bet, max_bet — for the UI and denomination checks.

cases.title: A first session opens at the bet level the back office configured

video.prompt:
Grandma Pets is a 5-reel, 4-row slot. This clip is the game sitting idle just after it loaded — no spin has been made.
(1) bet_text: read the bet amount shown, exactly as printed, as a string. "none" if no bet amount is displayed. (2) balance_readable: is a balance amount displayed? (3) spin_ready: does the game look ready to play — reels stopped, spin control present, no loading spinner and no popup covering the screen? (4) ui_broken: is anything overlapping, cut off, placeholder or visibly broken?
notes: one short sentence on anything the questions above do not cover.

data.notes: The video shows the game's initial loading screen followed by its idle state.
data.reason: The game successfully finishes loading and displays the main interface with a bet of 0.10 and a clear balance. All game controls are visible and appear ready for interaction.
